build_bert_model: build a BERT model with FP16 support and distributed data parallel training
run_bert_pretraining: run BERT pretraining with language modeling and next sentence prediction objectives
create_optimizer: create an Adam optimizer with weight decay parameter groups for BERT model training
evaluate_bert_model: evaluate a pre-trained BERT model on validation data and report LM and NSP losses
setup_learning_rate_scheduler: setup an annealing learning rate scheduler with warmup and decay for BERT training
